meldstudio.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to Meld Studio right now.

meldstudio.connect.description: Starts connecting to Meld Studio. It does not wait: Cuebot keeps trying in the background until it works.
meldstudio.connect.returns: true once connecting has started (not when it is connected).

meldstudio.getStatus.description: Tells you whether Meld Studio is connected, recording or live, and which scene is showing.
meldstudio.getStatus.returns: isConnected, isRecording, isStreaming (true/false), currentScene (its name, or null) and apiVersion.

meldstudio.showScene.description: Switches Meld Studio to another scene. Fails with an error when no scene matches or Meld Studio is not connected.

parameters.scene: The scene's name as Meld Studio shows it, like "Gameplay", or its id.

meldstudio.showScene.returns: The name of the scene that is now showing.

meldstudio.showSceneByName.description: Switches Meld Studio to another scene. Works just like meldstudio.showScene.

parameters.sceneName: The scene's name as Meld Studio shows it, like "Gameplay". An id works too.

meldstudio.showSceneByName.returns: The name of the scene that is now showing.

meldstudio.showLayer.description: Makes a layer in Meld Studio visible. Fails with an error when no layer matches.

parameters.layer: The layer's name, like "Webcam", or its id.
parameters.scene: Optional. The scene the layer is in. Leave it out to search the current scene first, then all scenes.

meldstudio.hideLayer.description: Hides a layer in Meld Studio. Fails with an error when no layer matches.

parameters.layer: The layer's name, like "Webcam", or its id.
parameters.scene: Optional. The scene the layer is in. Leave it out to search the current scene first, then all scenes.

meldstudio.setLayerVisibility.description: Shows, hides or flips a layer in Meld Studio. Fails with an error when no layer matches.

parameters.layer: The layer's name, like "Webcam", or its id.
parameters.scene: Optional. The scene the layer is in. Leave it out to search the current scene first, then all scenes.

meldstudio.setLayerVisibility.returns: true when the layer is visible now, false when hidden.

meldstudio.setEffectEnabled.description: Turns an effect on a Meld Studio layer on or off, like a blur or colour filter. Fails with an error when the layer or effect is not found.

parameters.layer: The layer's name, like "Webcam", or its id.
parameters.effect: The effect's name, like "Blur", or its id.
parameters.scene: Optional. The scene the layer is in. Leave it out to search the current scene first.

meldstudio.setEffectEnabled.returns: true when the effect is on now, false when off.

meldstudio.setTrackMuted.description: Mutes or unmutes an audio track in Meld Studio. Fails with an error when no track matches.

parameters.track: The audio track's name, like "Microphone", or its id.

meldstudio.setTrackMuted.returns: true when the track is muted now, false when not.

meldstudio.setTrackGain.description: Changes the volume (gain) of an audio track in Meld Studio. Fails with an error when no track matches.

parameters.track: The audio track's name, like "Music", or its id.
parameters.gain: The volume as a number from 0 (silent) to 1 (full), like 0.5. It must be a number, not text.

meldstudio.recording.description: Starts or stops recording in Meld Studio. Fails with an error when Meld Studio is not connected.
meldstudio.recording.returns: true when recording now, false when not.

meldstudio.streaming.description: Goes live or stops streaming in Meld Studio. Fails with an error when Meld Studio is not connected.
meldstudio.streaming.returns: true when streaming now, false when not.

meldstudio.screenshot.description: Takes a screenshot in Meld Studio.

parameters.vertical: Optional. true takes it of the vertical (phone) canvas. Default false.

meldstudio.sendCommand.description: Runs one of Meld Studio's own commands, like saving a clip or showing the replay.

parameters.command: The Meld command name, like "meld.recordClip" or "meld.replay.show".

meldstudio.getScenes.description: Lists your Meld Studio scenes in order.
meldstudio.getScenes.returns: A list of scenes. Each has id, name, current (true when showing) and staged (true when lined up next).

meldstudio.getSession.description: Gives you everything Meld Studio reports about your setup: scenes, layers, effects and audio tracks. For advanced scripts.
meldstudio.getSession.returns: An object with one entry per item, named by its id. Each entry holds the item's details as Meld Studio sends them.

meldstudio.invoke.description: Calls any of Meld Studio's own functions by name. For advanced users. Fails with an error when this Meld Studio version does not have it.

parameters.method: The Meld function name, like "setStagedScene". Needed.
parameters.args: Optional. A list of values to pass to it, like ["<scene id>"].

meldstudio.invoke.returns: Meld Studio's answer, or null when it gives none.
